norms.definition: Create things or changes that others have reason to value; uptake by an independent counterparty is evidence, internal applause is a hypothesis.
Make commitments answerable to evidence and preserve the ability to discover that they were wrong; a changed criterion does not rewrite what was promised.
Steward the resources and capabilities that make future worthwhile choices possible; spending for an enduring capability can be good stewardship, maintaining a dead institution is not.
Do not finance the factory's advantage by imposing unconsented costs on outsiders.

Measurements are defeasible evidence of the values, not substitutes for them. A favorable measurement is insufficient when supported consequences contradict the value it represents. Missing measurement alone is not evidence of failure.

proposal.description: Mean settled forecast skill against the pre-outcome prevalence baseline for each evaluator assembly; unmeasured when fewer than the required settled forecasts are available.
proposal.reason: Rewarding evaluators for forecasts that improve on a prevalence baseline ties judgement to evidence rather than confidence or conformity.

proposal.description: Mean population standard deviation among judges evaluating the same return; report only windows with at least two judges on a return.
proposal.reason: Visible disagreement helps prevent a single apparently favorable verdict from standing in for uncertain or contested evidence.

reasons: Reject: the cards use non-null lambda values, but no card in the submitted charter specifies lambda.
Reject: the cost and forecast-skill cards conflict with the charter’s existing card definitions and scopes, so adopting this whole edition would create inconsistent metrics.

The cards are measurable against registered observations with declared windows and regions, and the charter's norms and liability rules give a workable, falsifiable basis for holding commitments to account.
The cards are not preflightable: there are no closed-window observations, and several use forecast or return windows with fewer than the required samples.

The proposed charter keeps all five norms intact, uses valid card contracts on registered seed observations, and sets defensible floors and ceilings that tighten cost and concentration discipline without editing the world's measurement machinery.
